notable_absence.finding: No version or edition gating anywhere on the page for either plain Analytics views or TAVs - both are presented as generally-available DDL objects.

cross_component_finding: This page names a real, if unenforced, relational-modelling surface inside SQL++ for Analytics: TAV's PRIMARY KEY / FOREIGN KEY clauses ('these clauses ... enable you to specify which columns in the TAV serve as primary or foreign keys ... the primary and foreign key relationships are not enforced by Couchbase Analytics') and the DEFAULT NULL / NOT UNKNOWN casting rules exist purely so external relational tools (the Tableau Connector) can consume Couchbase's schemaless JSON model - a bridge concept with no counterpart anywhere else the corpus's data-model vocabulary has reached so far.
